## Introduction

Probabilistic PCA [@tipping1999ppca] (`pPCA`), its Dirichlet-loading variant (`pPCA_dir`) and
the ARD [@bishop1999bayesianpca] / supervised variants (`pPCA_ARD`, `spPCA`, `spPCA_ARD`), all in
`src/models.jl`. First on a simulated block-structured expression matrix,
then on untargeted metabolomics (ST001828 [@sud2016metabolomicsworkbench], negative-mode urine panel),
with NUTS [@hoffman2014nuts] and ADVI [@kucukelbir2017advi].

## Setup

The analysis runs in Julia [@bezanson2017julia]; `ExposomicsJulia` provides the shared helpers and models, together with DataFrames.jl [@bouchetvalat2023dataframes] and Turing.jl [@ge2018turing].

```{julia}
#| label: setup
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Plots, StatsBase, Distributions
using Turing, ReverseDiff
using Arrow
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

## Simulated expression matrix

A diagonal-block expression matrix with some non-informative genes (not all
features differ between cells).

```{julia}
#| label: simulated-expression-matrix
n_genes = 90   # D
n_cells = 600  # N
mat_exp = randn(n_genes, n_cells)
mat_exp[1:(n_genes ÷ 3), 1:(n_cells ÷ 2)] .+= 10
mat_exp[(2 * (n_genes ÷ 3) + 1):end, (n_cells ÷ 2 + 1):end] .+= 10;
```

`k` is the dimension of the projected space, i.e. the number of principal
components of choice.

```{julia}
#| label: simulated-expression-matrix-2
#| eval: false
k = 2
ppca = pPCA(permutedims(mat_exp), k)
chain_ppca = sample(ppca, NUTS(; adtype = AutoReverseDiff(; compile = true)), 1000);
Z = posterior_mean(chain_ppca, :Z)              # k × N latent scores
scatter(Z[1, :], Z[2, :]; group = repeat([1, 2]; inner = n_cells ÷ 2), xlabel = "z1", ylabel = "z2")
```

## Untargeted metabolomics (ST001828)

Metabolites with ≤ 25 missing samples (out of 100), median-imputed and
standardised (`omics_matrix`); first 10 metabolites to keep sampling fast.

```{julia}
#| label: untargeted-metabolomics-st001828
#| eval: false
df    = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "ST001828", "covariates.arrow")));
buneg = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "ST001828", "buneg.arrow")));
M_all, met_ids = omics_matrix(buneg, :metabolite, 2:101; max_missing = 25)
M_buneg = rescale(M_all[:, 1:10])
N, D = size(M_buneg)
```

pPCA with ADVI and NUTS:

```{julia}
#| label: untargeted-metabolomics-st001828-2
#| eval: false
ppca = pPCA(M_buneg, 2)
res_vi = vi(ppca, q_meanfield_gaussian, 1000; show_progress = false);
chain_ppca = sample(ppca, NUTS(), 1000);

Z  = posterior_mean(chain_ppca, :Z)
df_pca = DataFrame(z1 = Z[1, :], z2 = Z[2, :])
scatter(df_pca.z1, df_pca.z2; xlabel = "z1", ylabel = "z2", label = "NUTS")

# ADVI posterior mean of Z
Zvi = mean(rand(res_vi)[@varname(Z)] for _ in 1:1000)
scatter!(Zvi[1, :], Zvi[2, :]; label = "ADVI")     # sign of the axes is arbitrary
```

pPCA with Dirichlet (simplex) loadings and one component:

```{julia}
#| label: untargeted-metabolomics-st001828-3
#| eval: false
ppca_dir = pPCA_dir(M_buneg, 1)
chain_dir = sample(ppca_dir, NUTS(), 1000)
W = posterior_mean(chain_dir, :W)          # D × 1
Z = posterior_mean(chain_dir, :Z)          # 1 × N
μ = posterior_mean(chain_dir, :μ)
sum(W)                                  # loadings on the simplex
mat_rec = W * Z .+ repeat(μ; inner = (1, N))   # reconstruction (D × N)
```

## ARD and supervised pPCA

`pPCA_ARD(x, k)` lets the ARD prior switch off unnecessary components;
`spPCA`/`spPCA_ARD(x, y, k)` model the exposures `x` and an outcome `y`
with shared latent factors.

```{julia}
#| label: ard-and-supervised-ppca
#| eval: false
DT = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "clean_dt.arrow")));
x  = rescale(Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, names(DT, Between(:h_abs_ratio_preg_Log, :h_thm_preg_Log))]))
y  = Vector{Float64}(DT.bw_zscore)
chain_ard  = sample(pPCA_ARD(x, 5), NUTS(), 500)
chain_sard = sample(spPCA_ARD(x, y, 5), NUTS(), 500)
chain_summary(chain_ard; pattern = "alpha")
```
